estimate_bandwidth: estimate the bandwidth parameter for mean-shift clustering using quantile-based nearest neighbor distances
mean_shift: perform mean shift clustering on input data and return cluster centers and labels
get_bin_seeds: find initial seed points for mean shift by binning data onto a grid and selecting frequent bins
create_MeanShift: create a MeanShift clustering object and fit it to data to discover blobs in sample distributions
test_MeanShift_predict: test the MeanShift predict method to assign new samples to their closest cluster center
